learning_objective: 🎯 Master the super skills of measuring how heavy things are and how much liquid containers can hold!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: We measure the weight of objects to see how heavy they are. Light things like apples are measured in grams (g), and heavy things like a big watermelon are measured in kilograms (kg)!
Capacity tells us how much liquid a container can hold. A tiny medicine spoon holds just a few milliliters (mL), but a huge bucket holds many liters (L) of water.
Here is a magical math rule: 1000 grams make 1 kilogram, and 1000 milliliters make 1 liter! We use this trick to solve big measurement puzzles.

fun_activity.title: ⚖️ The Kitchen Pantry Hunt
fun_activity.instructions: Ask your parents to help you check the kitchen. Find one item that has its weight in grams (g) and one item that has its capacity in milliliters (mL). Write the numbers down!

quick_recap: ⭐ Grams (g) and kilograms (kg) are used to measure the weight of solid things.
⭐ Milliliters (mL) and liters (L) are used to measure the capacity of liquids.
⭐ Remember the magic number 1000 when converting between small and large units!
